title: Code annotation generation method, system and device based on federal learning
assignee: Ping An Technology Shenzhen Co Ltd

pse.problem: Existing methods for automatic generation of code annotations are often based on open-source projects, which may not meet specific company or organization's requirements. Also, due to limited internal data volume, an efficient model cannot be trained solely using existing data.
pse.solution_function: The system generates a high-performance code annotation model by forming a federal learning framework between a server and multiple clients. Each client trains their local model based on the initial parameter set sent from the server, then sends their optimized parameters back to the server for aggregation. The aggregated optimization parameters are used to train new models, which generate annotations for code sequences.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of a server and multiple clients, each client has a code annotation generation model. A blockchain stores the predefined sample data set, which includes source code samples and comment word samples.
pse.solution_implementation: The server initializes the model parameters and sends them to the clients. Each client performs initial training using their local data and the provided sample data from the blockchain. The optimized parameters are sent back to the server for aggregation. The aggregated optimization parameters are used to retrain all models, resulting in new code annotation generation models.
pse.effect: The solution offers a method that doesn't expose source code between companies and can be trained efficiently using both internal and external data.
